calls.title: AI Enablement Session
calls.summary: The meeting discussed GrowthBook's Agent Skills Platform, highlighting its capabilities in managing feature flags and experiments through markdown and JavaScript skills. The skills are compatible across various agents, enabling a broad customer base while emphasizing user-friendly features such as natural language interactions. A synthetic data workspace is being developed for standardized demos, aiming for improvement in user enablement. Cost considerations regarding token usage were reviewed, indicating internal usage costs remain low. The competitive landscape showed GrowthBook's skills as more comprehensive compared to others like Statsig and Optimizely, enhancing experimentation speed. Finally, transparency and human-in-the-loop design were noted as key aspects of user experience.
calls.keywords: agent skills, GrowthBook, feature flags, experiment lifecycle, AI automation, Claude Code
